spans.s: makara-saṅkramaṇa (SITI), entrance of the sun into Capricorn; commencement of the Tamil month Tai; same as Makara-saṅkrānti.

makara-toraṇa (EI 29), one of the royal insignia.
 (EI 3; SII 1, 3), an ornamental arch; an arch in the [] shape of a makara (crocodile); gateway with figures of crocodiles. Cf. Ep. Ind., Vol XXXV p. 107.

makarikā (CITD), figures of crocodiles drawn in gold dust on the cheeks and breasts of women; same as makarikā-patra.
 (EI 14), cf. mukuṭa-makarikā-marakata.
makuti (CII 4), an edict addressed to the Śūdras. Cf. Mākutika, official designation.
makkal̤-per̤u (SITI), Tamil; one's obligations as a citizen; probably, dues payable to a temple, or poll-tax.
